content.text: The verifier's narrative confirms the classification, citations, and empty redline are all correct; the single "failed" line item is the vacuous carve-out check, which cannot pass where no covenant exists. There is no substantive defect to repair, so I re-submit the same compliant finding with the rationale tightened to lead on that point.

input.quote: Each General Manager shall have the authority to make and convey decisions on behalf of each Party and to be the liaison with the other Party for all production and Content matters.
input.rationale: Compliant at the preferred position: the Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching restriction on the Company. The general-solicitation carve-out and 12-month duration checks fail only vacuously — there is no covenant in the document for them to qualify, so no carve-out is required and nothing can be narrowed. Basis: full reads of sec-p0001, sec-1.4, sec-5.4 (including the General Manager/liaison appointment at p0035, the point at which named individuals are put in contact and where a reciprocal no-hire would typically sit), Exclusivity §6, Confidentiality §8, Warranties §9 and General Provisions §10, plus targeted searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "employ or engage", "induce", "personnel" and "directly or indirectly". The only hits are incidental and impose no restriction: HDI's "employees, or agents" in the confidentiality carve-out (p0051) and "agent, partner, employee or representative" in the No Joint Venture clause (p0061). Because the rule's preferred position is "No non-solicit on Customer", the absence of any such covenant satisfies the rule outright; "missing" would be the wrong classification because the rule does not expect a restriction to exist. The Section 6 exclusivity covenants (including §6.1 binding the Company as to competing Deerskin-branded web projects) restrict competing projects rather than personnel and are handled under the separate exclusivity rule, so they are not double-flagged here. No redline and no counterparty comment are warranted, and the document text is unchanged.
